name: Drawer
description: A side panel for secondary navigation or contextual actions.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Interactive descendants must be reachable by keyboard and expose visible focus.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Standalone
examples.notes: Consumer-authored reference, no automatic prop binding. Prefix IDs before repeating.

behavior.keyboard: Escape closes the drawer; Tab and Shift+Tab remain within the panel.
behavior.dismissal: The explicit close button and optional scrim close the drawer and restore focus.

binding.html: textContent or accessible name appropriate to the element
see variantContracts; names do not imply data-variant support

right.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

compact.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

guidance.use: Show a nonmodal secondary panel with open/close, initial focus and focus restoration; Tab remains in normal document order.
guidance.avoid: Assuming it is a complete modal sheet with inert background.

label.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.
